draft.subject: Question about the Computer Vision and Deep Learning role at D3
draft.body:
My name is Justin Mascarenhas, I recently finished my M.S. in Computer Engineering at Rochester Institute of Technology. I noticed you lead computer vision and deep learning work at D3 and came up through the same intern to full time path there, which is the kind of route I am hoping to find for myself.

D3 has an opening for a Computer Vision and Deep Learning Engineer and most of my recent work lines up closely with it, real time perception and deep learning models deployed on Jetson class edge hardware, along with segmentation and GPU kernel work from my degree. I would appreciate any detail you could share about what the team is looking for, and if you would be willing to refer me or point me to the right person that would mean a lot.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
draft.hook_used: Karthik holds the senior version of the exact open role (Sr. Computer Vision and Deep Learning Engineer) at D3, came up through the same intern to full time path, and is a PhD candidate in the same applied ML/robotics domain
